basics.name: Mainul Hossain
basics.label: Site Reliability Engineer
basics.summary: Versatile Site Reliability Engineer with a strong background in cloud infrastructure, automation, and security remediation across large multi-subscription Azure/AWS tenants. Hands-on expertise in Kubernetes/AKS lifecycle management, Terraform, Azure Policy & Defender for Cloud remediation, and scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell, Ruby) for automation, monitoring, and API integrations. Builds AI-assisted reliability tooling (LLM + ML forecasting/anomaly detection) with real-time dashboards and end-to-end observability; research interests include ML, deep learning, and explainable AI (XAI).

highlights: Built an AI-powered infrastructure monitoring tool and Agent Prompt Optimization workflow forecasting Black Friday readiness, cutting manual analysis time 30%.
Built a Terraform-managed Datadog Workflow that auto-restarts the Datadog agent on Elasticsearch via Azure RunCommand, supporting a 99.99% SLA and cutting manual intervention 50%.
Led a tenant-wide Defender for Cloud/Advisor security remediation program across 5 global regions and 200+ VMs, and a full AKS cluster upgrade (v1.32 to v1.33.x) across 48 clusters.

Supported on-call/support rotations resolving P1 incidents; implemented Azure automation for .NET Core proactive monitoring, cutting investigation time 70%.
